items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I like the Ann Hager's blues in there and all that stuck in, you know, those little parts. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well Sharky puts that in there.

ctx.x: That's right. If you're gonna play it, start it from the introduction and, and carry it on through. Just like the, give the trombone man the solo that, that, that took. Take it out. Now if you wanna put an added chorus like Sharky does into it, something of his own, put it in. That's alright. But play most of it the way the rhythm kings.
I like the Ann Hager's blues in there and all that stuck in, you know, those little parts.
Yeah, well Sharky puts that in there.
